NOTICE OF HEARING

PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine will bring his Motion Under
Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 26(d)(1) for Leave to Serve Four Limited Interrogatories on Meta
Platforms, Inc. Before the Rule 26(f) Conference for hearing before the Honorable Ivan D. Davis,
United States Magistrate Judge, on Friday, September 25, 2026, at 10:00 a.m., in Alexandria
Courtroom 301, or at such other time as the Court may direct.

Plaintiff and counsel for Meta conferred by telephone on September 3, 2026 regarding the
Motion and the September 25, 2026 hearing date. Meta stated that it does not agree to answer the
four interrogatories and takes no position on September 25, 2026 as the hearing date.

Plaintiff therefore notices this Motion for hearing on the same date and time presently set
for Plaintiff’s pending Rule 26(d)(1) Motion directed to NCMEC (ECF No. 15) and Rule 15(d)

Motion (ECF No. 26).
